rationale: Repair snapshot-identity guards introduced on the current 1.84 transport line. Ordinary HA state replacement retains the existing connection/user authority and operation generation; genuinely retired authorities remain fenced.

summary.ru: Устранена ложная ошибка смены контекста после успешного сохранения при обновлении состояний HA.
summary.en: Avoid false context-change errors after successful writes during ordinary HA state updates.
